in_marathi.name: Jesika
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of wealth
in_marathi.long_meaning: Jesika हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Jesika is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Jesana', which means 'Goddess of wealth'. In Hindu mythology, Jesana is the goddess of prosperity, abundance, and good fortune. She is often depicted carrying a lotus flower or a gold coin, symbolizing wealth and abundance. Jesika is a beautiful and meaningful name for a baby girl in Hindu culture.
